messages:
carmen: hey — noticing delayed secret propagation in staging after a vault rotation. auth-svc + rerank-svc kept the old creds for ~2-3m. using ExternalSecrets (vault bridge) with annotation ttl=30s. started ~09:12 UTC. any quick guesses?

raj: can you paste the ExternalSecret and controller logs? also which mount method (env vs projected volume) are these apps using?

maria: quick outputs:
```
$ kubectl get externalsecret auth-secret -n staging -o yaml
metadata:
  annotations:
    externalsecret.kubernetes.io/last-sync: "2026-03-16T09:12:10Z"
spec:
  backendType: vault
  refreshInterval: "30s"
```
and on one pod: `kubectl exec -n staging auth-svc-7d9f8 -c app -- printenv | grep AUTH_KEY` -> shows old masked value.

deploy-bot: rotation-job: completed vault rotation for path=secret/data/team/auth at 2026-03-16T09:11:35Z :white_check_mark:

lee: if those are env vars then k8s won't refresh them in a running container. envFrom/secretRef are read at container start only. projected volumes or CSI-mount can refresh without restart.

carmen: ugh, yep they're env vars. i assumed ExternalSecrets would hot-reload. restarting the pod picks the new value.

raj: yep that's expected behavior. ExternalSecrets updates the Kubernetes Secret resource; how the app picks it up depends on mount type. For env vars you need a restart/rollout. For auto-refresh use secrets-store-csi-driver (or projected volumes + sidecar).

maria: also saw some controller logs that suggest brief backoff: `W 09:11:50 rate limited fetching vault secret, retrying in 30s` — could explain the 2-3m window in some cases.

lee: can you paste the exact log lines? if the bridge hit a rate limit or transient Vault latency that would stall the k8s Secret update and make restarts still get old values until controller completes the sync.

carmen: paste of pod events / externalsecret describe:
```
Events:
  Type    Reason       Age   From                 Message
  ----    ------       ----  ----                 -------
  Normal  Created      5m    externalsecret.ctrl  Created k8s Secret auth-secret
  Warning SyncError    4m    externalsecret.ctrl  rate limited fetching vault secret
  Normal  Synced       2m    externalsecret.ctrl  Secret auth-secret updated
```

matt: quick mitigation — rolling restart the deployments so env vars refresh: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/auth-svc -n staging` and `kubectl rollout restart deploy/rerank-svc -n staging`. i kicked them off.

raj: long term: we should either move short-lived creds to CSI driver or ensure rolling restart is part of rotation automation. creating infra ticket to decide.

matt: created INFRA-462 to evaluate CSI + secrets rotation automation. linking runbook.

infra-bot: incident-tracker: ticket INFRA-462 created (priority: P3) by matt.

carmen: restarting fixed it for now — pods are picking up the new creds. i'll leave monitoring for the next rotation and report if lag > 1m. thanks everyone :raised_hands:

raj: :thumbsup: note for docs — add a short note in the secrets playbook about env vs volume behavior and recommended patterns for short-lived tokens.

maria: i'll add a short blurb and link the ticket.

lee: i'll look into the bridge rate-limiting; might need adjusted concurrency or backoff jitter.

carmen: great. closing here unless anyone sees recurrence.
